subject: general
question: A car covers a certain distance in 85 minutes, if it runs at a speed of 36 km/hr. The speed at which the car must run to reduce the time of journey to 51 minutes will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Initial time (t₁) = 85 minutes

Initial speed (s₁) = 36 km/hr

Reduced time (t₂) = 51 minutes

**Formula used:**

Distance (d) = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Convert time from minutes to hours:

t₁ = 85 minutes = dfrac{85}{60} hours
